docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY AYALA CARLOS AS TO DEFENDANT FLAMENCO MANUEL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-12-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT MAIL TO MANUEL FLACENCO RETURNED SIGNED.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AYALA CARLOS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FLAMENCO MANUEL $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,020.00, THIS CASE COVERS ONLY DAMAGE TO ALLSTATE INSURED CAR NOT ANY CLAIMS THAT MR CARLOS AYALA MAY HAVE STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
